paragraphs.en: The strict > condition leaves equal earlier values in place, so the fixture is stable.

paragraphs.en: The saved key is written once after the loop into Position+1.

theory.code:
PROCEDURE InsertionSort(BYREF Data : ARRAY[0:4] OF INTEGER)
  DECLARE Index : INTEGER
  DECLARE Position : INTEGER
  DECLARE Key : INTEGER
  FOR Index ← 1 TO 4
    Key ← Data[Index]
    Position ← Index - 1
    WHILE (Position >= 0) AND (Data[Position] > Key)
      Data[Position + 1] ← Data[Position]
      Position ← Position - 1
    ENDWHILE
    Data[Position + 1] ← Key
  NEXT Index
ENDPROCEDURE
